newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Medical settles SEC probe.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Medical settles SEC probe.

text.p: Advanced Medical Products Inc said on Tuesday it settled its accounting probe with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

The company said in a statement SEC accepted its offer to settle on September 5. In the offer, Advanced Medical, Vice President James Brown and former President Clarence Groff signed a consent decree to cease and desist from committing or causing any violations and future violations of the Securities and Exchange Act.
The offer to settle was not an admission or denial, the company said.
The company said the settlement had no financial implications and merely involved the signing of the consent decree.
It ended a private investigation of the company's accounting and record keeping practices started by the SEC on February 16, 1993.
